reason: A blacksmith's hammer changes into the ear's hammer bone; the eardrum turns into musical sound.
A caravan trailer becomes a film trailer; a cinema screen becomes a window screen.
A duck's bill becomes a financial bill, and a banknote becomes a musical note.
Orange changes from fruit to paint colour; canvas changes from painting surface to a sail.
A skate blade becomes a saw blade; wood becomes paper and then a dining table.
Puffin changes from a bird to a publisher; printing ink becomes cuttlefish ink.
A slice becomes a chip, then a computer string becomes a puppet's string.
Mint changes from making coins to a herb; sage then changes from herb to philosopher.
Nightingale changes from bird to nurse; an operating theatre becomes a musical theatre.

A trombone slide becomes a sliding drawer in a chest; treasure leads into the sea.

Mango chutney fills a jar; vessel changes from a container to an airship.
A saw blade reaches a bone and elbow; elbow changes from joint to pasta shape.
Sage changes from herb to wise thinker; political thought leads into government.
Onion layers become map layers; a map's scale changes into a musical scale.
A fennel bulb becomes a light bulb, then a harbour light guides boats into a marina.

A clerical collar leads to a church organ; an organ becomes another musical instrument.
A sardine tin becomes a paint tin, then paint moves to an artist's easel.
Lotus changes from flower to car; an engine's pitch becomes a sung musical pitch.
Shrimp changes into something small; a scale model becomes a measured slope for a toboggan.
A fluttering petal suggests wings and flight; an aircraft crash turns into a cymbal crash.
An artist's beret suggests a paintbrush; brush changes from painting and scrubbing to hair.
A suit becomes a legal court; court changes to a clay tennis court, then fired clay becomes a brick terrace.
Reeds become wicker and a cane, then a measuring stick becomes a construction tool.
Fruit sugar forms crystals; rock changes from mineral to music and a stringed instrument.
Larch timber becomes a bow, then a poisoned arrow suggests venom and a mongoose's adversary.
Scales become a musical tune, then a whistle changes from singing to a steaming teapot.
Mink fur leads to woven thread and fibre; fibre changes from textile material to fruit fibre.
A wrench leads to a steam pipe; steam changes from a power source to a way to cook dumplings.
A deer's horn becomes a musical horn, then brass changes from an instrument material to a cannon.
A boat's bow becomes an archer's bow, then a cello bow and string.
A shell changes from a scallop's covering to an explosive projectile before the route returns to fish.
A gingerbread house has windows; a window changes from a house window to a cockpit window.
A fish market becomes a stock market, then a financial note becomes a musical note.

Chickpeas cook in a steaming pot; steam changes from cooking to powering a locomotive.
A die's cube becomes a sugar cube and sugar crystals, then honey leads to a beehive.

A pistachio nut becomes a metal nut and bolt; bolt changes into a running horse.
A seaweed wrap becomes wrapping paper and a rolled cone, then a cone becomes a brass horn.
Wren changes from bird to architect, then a building changes from church to pagoda.
A tooth crown becomes a royal crown; a monarch's navy supplies a galleon.
A bracelet charm changes from ornament to a magical charm.
The berries on holly suggest berry preserves; jam and cream lead to a scone.
Peering through a keyhole reaches a lens and glass; a bottle neck becomes a shirt necktie.
